test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 4 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.**

He said, “I have got the prize”.

options.text: He said that he has got the prize.
He said that he had got the prize.
He said, he have got the prize.
He said that I had got the prize.

solution:
The correct answer is '**He said that he had got the prize.**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in Direct Speech. As per the given question, we have to change it to Indirect Speech.
 
• The process of transformation is as follows:
 
 
• The reporting verb will not change because it does not have an object. 
 
• Commas and inverted commas will be removed. 
 
• The conjunction 'that' will be added. 
 
• 'I' will be changed into 'he' because the **first-person** pronouns are changed according to the subject of the reporting verb. 
 
• Present Perfect Tense 'have got' will be changed into **Past Perfect Tense** 'had got'. 
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is Option 2. 

 ​
 
 

Correct Sentence:__ *He said that he had got the prize.*
